title: NACHTSCHICHT - Higgsfield motion pass
note: Each clip animates one existing plate as its start frame, so the look of the still cut carries over.

shots.prompt: One continuous real shot. Camera: slow, steady crane rise of about half a metre with a gentle push toward the TV tower. What moves: low clouds slide across the tower, its red aviation lights blink once per second, a few apartment windows switch on and off, thin rain crosses the frame, the rusty antenna trembles in the wind. Photographed on an ARRI Alexa 35 with anamorphic lenses, 24 fps, 180-degree shutter with natural motion blur, real-time speed, fine film grain, deep teal-black shadows and warm sodium highlights. Keep the start frame's composition, lighting and colours exactly. No people, no text, no logos, no new objects appearing, no morphing, no cuts, no slow motion.
